description: Geoscience Australia Flood Study Summary Web Services is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The Flood Study Summary Services support discovery and retrieval of flood hazard information. The services return metadata and data for flood studies and flood inundation maps held in the 'Australian Flood Studies Database'. The same information is available through a user interface at ga. gov. au/flood-study-web/. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU, GIS Dataset, National, Natural Hazards, Published_External. It offers 13 resource(s) in html, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
